answer: Honeypot decoy audit resists sybils: the grading stream is seeded with decoy answers that are machine-invalid yet plausible to a grader not judging on merit. An identity that approves a honeypot reveals it rubber-stamps rather than reads, and a colluding ring passing everything meets decoys at a rate rising with its approval volume. A raven-sly farm cannot wander past them without reading each answer — the cost it skips. The harbor of honest graders passes, since decoys fail objective checks they already run. Precondition: decoys are indistinguishable to colluders and planted unpredictably.
